name: Source-Checked Semantic Model Creation
description: Inspect explicit source metadata and gate native semantic-model creation with the same bounded checks. No silent mode switching, table conversion, grants, or framing submissions.

variables.NAME: Chosen new model name.
variables.URL: Canonical HTTPS OneLake table URL, including source workspace/item UUIDs and the actual table path.
variables.LH: Explicit source lakehouse UUID when deliberately choosing generation.

steps.description: Read-only source observations. Review status, bounds and notChecked; unknown is not compatibility.
Offline native creation preview. Input validation runs, but source checks are not performed or certified by dry-run.

Recheck immediately before the creation POST. Every finding must be ready; otherwise print not_created/sourceCheck and stop. Capture the returned model ID. Source readiness does not establish model/framing/query readiness.

explicit_generated_alternative.description: A separately chosen schema-aware generator path, NOT an automatic retry of native creation. Both generator storage modes can use the shared gate; preserve the requested storage mode. SQL discovery precedes the bounded OneLake phase and still runs under generator dry-run.
